editorial:
Imagine you are listening to your favorite radio show where a smart psychologist helps people with their problems. That is exactly how you enter this story. You get to follow a woman who uses her skills to figure out why wealthy women are being murdered. It starts off as a cool mystery, but things get scary fast. You will feel the tension rise as she realizes that the killer is not just some random person, but someone who has a very scary obsession with her. The vibe is like a classic crime novel where you are always looking over your shoulder.

The acting is solid and the plot twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts feel a bit like an old TV movie, the suspense makes up for it. If you love stories about obsessed villains and smart leads, you should definitely give this a try. Since it is an older title, you might want to track down a 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to get the best picture. If you are just browsing, try renting it on Apple TV or streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp experience.
endingExplained: You find out that the killer was much closer to the main character than she ever thought. The twist reveals that the murderer was obsessed with her voice from the radio show. In the final scenes, the killer tries to trap her to keep her forever. After a tense fight and a lucky break, she manages to outsmart him and survive. The police arrive just in time to wrap everything up and put the bad guy away.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and detective stories.
